more_than_10_proposals.evidence: 100 consecutive outer-loop proposal/evaluation steps; seven successive promoted versions; roughly nine of ten rewrites rejected

persistent_recursive_lineage.evidence: outer loop edits the inner autoresearch harness and later proposals operate from improved incumbent versions

hidden_selection_surface.evidence: inner evaluations have public/private splits; survival is decided by hidden private score

candidate_local_anytime_valid_evidence.evidence: public description says a rewrite is kept when better than previous best; public report notes run-to-run noise around 0.02-0.045 and several deltas within that range

bounded_selection_feedback_bandwidth.evidence: technical report, code, and proposal-level chronology are not yet public in the inspected sources

complete_proposal_chronology.evidence: blog manually summarizes one seed's rejected proposals but does not publish the full machine-readable chronology

untouched_outer_test.evidence: MLE-Bench Lite, ALE-Bench Lite, and WeatherBench 2 are reported as external benchmarks never used for selection; AIDE47 and AIDE85 both beat AIDE0 on all three, with non-monotonic AIDE47/AIDE85 ordering on MLE

safeguard_preservation.evidence: the statistical anti-hack layer had worked in an earlier version but was broken by a later mutation and effectively had no impact on AIDE85

independent_process_audit_target.finding: uncorrected self-awareness appears in 660/800 trajectories (82.5%): agents can identify a fatal flaw yet leave the final conclusion unchanged; artifact-aware judging attains substantially higher agreement than single-call judging in the reported audit
independent_process_audit_target.interpretation: endpoint reward alone can miss evidence-to-claim inconsistency; this supports a separate warrant/process gate but does not prove that such a gate improves a self-evolving system

smallest_missing_composition_edge: artifact/evidence warrant gate independent of the private performance score
content-addressed immutable promotion plus complete proposal log
outer benchmarks never used for selection, rollback, routing, or stopping
scope_guards: Do not claim AIDE² already has anytime-valid or familywise-valid promotion control.
Do not claim the external benchmarks were independently reproduced; only their reported non-selection role and results are source-bound here.
Do not infer that the broken anti-hack layer caused a measured deployment failure; it is evidence of safeguard regression under evolution, not a quantified causal attribution.
Do not treat AutoResearchEval's diagnostic findings as an intervention result.
revisit_conditions: Weco publishes the promised technical report or AIDE85 code
a proposal-level run ledger or exact promotion predicate becomes public
a new paper/repository reports the full composition edge with >10 proposals
